<!-- This article is taken directly from the Codex, and needs to be Wookified -->
The '''Wound''' was a deep chasm located in the middle of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The bottom of the site was impossible to see from the upper ridge, while the rim of the location was filled with camps of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]]. The Sand People seemed to have shown a reverance towards the Wound and were occasionally seen casting their dead into its depths.<ref name="TORC" />

Its origins were largely unknown as most considered it to be a natural formation. However, certain fringe geologists instead speculated that it was created by a violent [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] during ancient times. However, they lacked any evidence to support their theory and many wondered why anyone would decide to bombard a remote desolate world such as Tatooine.<ref name="TORC" />
